repo.description:
### Impact

A topic's "featured link" was not sufficiently sanitized before being rendered in the topic list, allowing a user who can set a featured link to inject JavaScript code into the rendered markup (stored XSS). Any user viewing a topic list that includes the affected topic could be targeted.

This vulnerability only affects sites which have modified or disabled Discourse's default Content Security Policy. On sites running the default CSP, the XSS cannot be exploited.

### Workarounds

Keep the Content Security Policy enabled (the `content_security_policy` site setting) and ensure its `script-src` directive does not allow inline scripts. In particular, do not add `'unsafe-inline'` to the `content_security_policy_script_src` site setting, as that is what permits injected JavaScript code to execute. Site owners may also disable the `topic_featured_link_enabled` site setting until they are able to upgrade.
repo.summary: Topic featured link susceptible to stored XSS
